Keep their original features and outlines. Photoreal studio packaging and podium combined with faithful clean 2D illustrated mascots. Balanced compact composition with all products and characters fully visible, subtle grounding shadows, generous white margins, camera almost frontal slightly elevated. White and brand red supporting surfaces; color from source products. No webpage, UI, captions, headings, buttons, decorative typography, watermark or claims. Existing text appears only on original packs.
